title: Home profile
description: The per-customer home profile (spec section 3.2). This file is the single source of the profile field list. Every field exists in every profile. A field that nothing filled has value 'unknown', confidence 0, source 'none', evidence null, doubt false. Field choice follows the KH 90-00394 section list (foundations and base floor, drains, roof, wet rooms, ventilation, heating, electrics, water and sewer, fireplaces and flues) and the Kunnon Koti seasonal to-do list.

house_type.description: Building type. Decides which catalogue entries apply at all (KH 90-00394 scope: detached and row houses).

building_year.description: Year of completion. The main age proxy for every building part that has no renovation year.

heating.description: Main heating system (KH section: Lammitys). Oil implies a tank and a flue; wood and pellet imply a flue.

panel_type.description: Main electrical panel fuse type (KH section: Sahkoistys). Screw fuses mark an original installation.

pipe_material.description: Tap-water pipe material (KH section: Vesi- ja viemarilaitteet). Galvanized steel and old copper drive leak risk.

roof_material.description: Roof covering (KH section: Ylapohja, ullakko ja vesikatto). Service life differs by material.

last_pipe_renovation.description: Year of the last tap-water or sewer pipe renovation. 'unknown' means no record, which the catalogue treats as never.

last_electrical_check.description: Date of the last electrical inspection by an electrician. A confirmed electrical work order writes the confirmation date here.

ventilation.description: Ventilation system type (KH section: Ilmanvaihto). Mechanical units need filter changes and a service interval.

sauna.description: Sauna stove type (KH section: Tulisijat ja hormit). Tukes counts sauna stoves among the top electrical fire causes. A wood stove implies a flue.

bathroom_waterproofing_year.description: Year the wet-room waterproofing was installed (KH section: Markatilat ja kosteat tilat). Finnish building code required a waterproof membrane from 1998.

floor_drain_type.description: Wet-room floor drain material (KH: vedeneristeen liitos lattiakaivoon). Finance Finland's 2013 leak study puts drains at 21 percent of leak claims.

water_heater_year.description: Year the hot-water tank was installed (KH section: Vesi- ja viemarilaitteet). Tanks corrode from the inside and leak at the end of their service life.

foundation_type.description: Foundation and base floor type (KH section: Perustukset ja alapohjarakenteet). Crawl spaces and basements carry the known moisture risk structures.

subsoil_drains.description: Whether the house has a subsoil drain system (KH section: Rakennuksen vierusta, salaoja- ja sadevesijarjestelmat).

last_roof_renovation.description: Year the roof covering was last replaced. 'unknown' means the covering is as old as the house.

oil_tank_year.description: Year the oil tank was installed (KH section: Lammitys, oljysailion vuodot). Only meaningful when heating is oil.

last_chimney_sweep.description: Date of the last chimney sweep (Kunnon Koti autumn to-do: sweep the flue once a year).

last_moisture_inspection.description: Date of the last moisture inspection of the foundation, base floor and drains (KH 90-00394 sections Perustukset ja alapohjarakenteet, Salaojat). A confirmed moisture inspection writes the confirmation date here.

last_ventilation_service.description: Date of the last service of the mechanical ventilation unit by a ventilation technician (KH section: Ilmanvaihto; Kunnon Koti spring and autumn to-do: change the filters and check the unit). A confirmed ventilation work order writes the confirmation date here.

source.description: Trust rank for the merge: partner > document > register > customer. 'none' when nothing filled the field.

evidence.description: Where the value came from, or null.

doubt.description: True when the winning value has confidence below 0.5 (decision 36). Later work; phase 1 always sets false.
